# Awesome Investor Agent Skills

> Web-first catalog and one portable agent skill for investor research: filings, public market data, portfolio maths, and leakage-safe backtesting. Research and simulation only — never personalized investment advice.

Audience: researchers and builders mapping public financial tooling into a source-backed agent workflow, plus agents asked to shortlist investor or quant tooling. Not for anyone looking for trade signals or capital allocation.

## How to use

No package install and no build step. The catalog is `README.md`; the weekly research loop is described there and run by `.github/workflows/weekly-harvest.yml`.

Health checks, the same ones CI runs:

    node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs
    node --test "scripts/*.test.mjs"

Run the harvester yourself (it only proposes):

    GITHUB_TOKEN=... node scripts/harvest.mjs

To use the skill, copy the folder into a skills directory your agent reads (for example `.agents/skills/` in a project):

    git clone https://github.com/Agentic-Income/awesome-investor-agent-skills
    cp -r awesome-investor-agent-skills/skills/investor-research <your-project>/.agents/skills/

## Key files

- `README.md` — the catalog: curated table, weekly research loop, contribution standard, research method.
- `skills/investor-research/SKILL.md` — the skill: inputs, rules, and the required output shape, ending in a human approval gate.
- `data/repos.json` — reviewed entries, each carrying category, asset class, execution risk, privacy risk, why included, what it is not for, and a review date.
- `data/sources.json` — the search sources the weekly harvester watches. Edit this to change what is monitored.
- `scripts/harvest.mjs` — opens a pull request with a report; it never adds an entry on its own.
- `reports/` — dated harvest reports.
- `docs/paths/` — path docs for crypto investing, general investor research, OSS terminal work, risk and custody, and trading systems.
- `AGENTS.md` — repo classification, health commands, and agent rules.

## Scope and exclusions

- Research, memo, backtest, and simulation outputs only. No live trading, no capital movement, no wallet actions.
- Execution-adjacent projects are labeled as such; keep their use to public data and simulation.
- Licence traps are named up front. Never copy code from AGPL, GPL, unlicensed, or custom-licence projects into another repository.
- A human reviewer decides what enters `data/repos.json`. Harvest output is a proposal, and SPDX detection is a hint, not a judgement.
- No secrets, private positions, account data, or wallet material.
- Nothing here is investment, legal, tax, accounting, or compliance advice, and inclusion is not an endorsement.
- Content is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
